changes: Added a typed terminal open identity and read-only recovery API. The operation store retains only terminalId plus document/connection ownership metadata, validates accepted identities, and rejects conflicting terminal results.

Terminal opening retains its operation identity after HTTP uncertainty. An already received accepted WebSocket receipt restores the requested terminal; later accepted results can be queried explicitly to recover interaction or close the terminal without replaying terminal/open.

Project changes retain an unresolved prior-project operation for closure only. Worker connection generation changes invalidate terminal interaction; old identities are never adopted or deliberately sent through replacement leases. Failed closure leaves a visible close retry while input is paused.
Kept the existing bounded serialized terminal input queue. Pending creation output remains bounded and ordered; overflow closes the confirmed terminal.
Coordinated the App epoch input with the parent so the terminal connection key includes both runtime epoch and connection revision. The parent owns that App edit and static terminal import.
